observations: Photo 0: A white console with a black glossy top panel is shown standing vertically. Two controllers are in front: one white with black grips, one pink with black grips. A white box with orange accents (possibly a Nintendo Switch box) is visible to the left. A blue box is to the right. The console has a visible 'SONY' logo on the side.
Photo 1: Side view of the same console, showing the 'SONY' logo clearly on the right side. The white and pink controllers are in front. The background shows shelves with various items.

Photo 2: Front view of the console, showing the white body and black top. The white and pink controllers are in front. The same white box with orange accents is visible to the left. The console appears to be a PlayStation 5 Slim model based on its shape and design.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI CENTVTECH LTD'.

claims.claim: PlayStation 5 slim console with 2pads and fc24
claims.evidence: The console and two controllers (pads) are visible in the photos. However, there is no visible evidence of the game 'FC24' (FIFA 24) in any of the photos. The game disc or case is not shown.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, cooling, or internal damage).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game or running a system test.

risks.risk: The controllers may be non-functional or have battery/charging issues.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: The game 'FC24' may not be included or may be a pirated copy.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the physical game case or disc for 'FC24' (FIFA 24).

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished or used unit with hidden wear or damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's ports, vents, and internal components (if opened) to check for dust, corrosion, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Photo or video of the 'FC24' game disc or case.
Video showing the console powering on and booting up.
Video showing both controllers connecting and functioning.
Close-up photos of the console's ports and vents.
response.reason: The console and two controllers are visible and identifiable as a PlayStation 5 Slim. However, the claim of including 'FC24' cannot be verified from the photos, and the functional condition of the console and controllers is unknown. Proof is needed to confirm the game's inclusion and the item's working state.
